paper_title: On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies
key_concepts: Constancy of the speed of light
summary: The podcast discusses Einstein's 1905 paper, "On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies," focusing on how it addresses inconsistencies in classical physics, particularly regarding electromagnetism and the concept of the luminiferous ether. It explains Einstein's two postulates—the principle of relativity and the constancy of the speed of light—and how these lead to counter-intuitive consequences like the relativity of simultaneity and time dilation, using thought experiments such as the light clock.
